body:
Before using TickTick, I felt bored and insignificant. Listing your goals, being organized, listing your task and making good habits makes you feel occupied and happy.

It’s also fun to list ideas and bucket lists that you can do in the future. You often forget these things but TickTick makes it sure that every good ideas, videos, articles and thoughts can be saved in a neat, smart place.

title: Gives you a productivity boost
body:
The app helps one to be organized. I felt at first as if it wasn’t that intuitive to use (e.g. couldn’t find the settings, where to set events, templates, etc.), but I couldn’t help but wonder what people are raving about in the reviews. So I tried to read about the different features and now I love it. I maintain 3 separate physical notebooks for different things, but all of them have been nicely captured and catered in the app now. 

Some of the many great features:
* Making a template. Very useful for lists that are constant. You can add the template as a to-do, but can also add some more items to the list (once it’s in the calendar) without affecting the template. 
* Creating sub-tasks. Very helpful for situations like grocery shopping. You don’t want a long list of to-dos filled only with grocery items. This groups the items so list looks much cleaner. 
* Folders and sub-folders. Keeps things organized. 
* Arrange Tasks feature. Lets you see overdue tasks and allows you to re-schedule them on your own and not just pile up in and clutter the next day. 

I haven’t dived into every feature yet, but I can see how helpful they are when I start really using them. 

Nice to have: 
* To show tasks as textboxes in the calendar month-view, to easily distinguish an event from a task. 
* Allow changing of color for the other iCloud categories so that it can match the color of the corresponding categories in TickTick. 
* Add events that can be categorized as one of the categories in TickTick. 

Thank you for this app! Hopefully we get a lifetime subscription plan.

body:
I’ve been in search for the best to do list apps for YEARS. I have read any “Best todo list apps” article and tried each app there is. And finally, I can say that I have found THE best! It’s been two years since I have started using this app and I have not used all the features you offer yet, there is a lot. For me, it’s an all-in-one app! I get to have a calendar, a habit tracker, to do list, pomodoro, and also a search function. It’s so generous, what else does this app offer that I don’t know yet?! 

The UI is a beauty. I myself is a very picky person when it comes to frontend design, but what you have is just perfectly done. I’m inlove. What I’d like to see in the future is to have more color options for the widgets or make the widget color similar to the theme/color selected in-app and make the text a little smaller for the Daily View widget. I’m excited to have that feature so please please let us have it!

Congratulations to the developers and the whole team! This is a perfect app you have made, really makes our lives easier.

title: DAMN BEST PRODUCTIVITY APP EVER
